about: The Library's doors to print, one record (scripts/inject_support.py reads it; the scraping-amazon-affiliate-link skill writes it). books: Amazon affiliate boxes, each a SiteStripe link (asin + linkId, tag lerinspress-20). doors: boxes to the press's recommendation shelves. shelves: each Library shelf's catch-all (a book, a door, or "lerins:<slug>" for our own edition on sale) (its overview and every work without its own). works: a page's own book or door, {lerins: slug} for our own edition's card, {miss: why, date} for a search that found no good edition, {hand: why} for a page that carries a box written by hand. places: an app page that carries a book outside the Library (community: the board's front page, its box written in app/views/board.ts and held to this entry by the test).

summa-dominican-5vol.words: Would you like the Summa in print? The English Dominican translation read here comes as a five-volume hardcover set.
summa-dominican-5vol.label: Buy on Amazon (Hardcover, 5 volumes)

luther-galatians-crossway.words: Would you like Luther’s Galatians in print? The Crossway Classic Commentaries edition, edited by Alister McGrath and J. I. Packer, is in paperback.
luther-galatians-crossway.label: Buy Luther on Galatians on Amazon (Paperback)

jewel-apology-davenant.words: Would you like Jewel’s Apology in print? The Davenant Press edition, edited by Robin Harris and Andre Gazal, is in paperback.
jewel-apology-davenant.label: Buy the Apology on Amazon (Paperback)

gibbons-faith-tan.words: Would you like The Faith of Our Fathers in print? TAN Books keeps Cardinal Gibbons’s classic in paperback.
gibbons-faith-tan.label: Buy the Faith of Our Fathers on Amazon (Paperback)

councils-davis.words: Would you like the councils in print? Leo Donald Davis’s The First Seven Ecumenical Councils (325–787): Their History and Theology is in paperback from the Liturgical Press.
councils-davis.label: Buy the First Seven Ecumenical Councils on Amazon (Paperback)

guettee-papacy-uncut.words: Would you like Guettée’s The Papacy in print? Uncut Mountain Press keeps it in paperback.
guettee-papacy-uncut.label: Buy the Papacy on Amazon (Paperback)

irenaeus-book3-acw.words: Would you like Irenaeus in print? Against the Heresies, Book 3, is in Paulist’s Ancient Christian Writers series, in paperback.
irenaeus-book3-acw.label: Buy Against the Heresies, Book 3 on Amazon (Paperback)

tertullian-baptism-evans.words: Would you like Tertullian’s On Baptism in print? Ernest Evans’s edition, with the text, translation and commentary, is in paperback.
tertullian-baptism-evans.label: Buy Tertullian on Baptism on Amazon (Paperback)

cyprian-church-svs.words: Would you like Cyprian in print? On the Church: Select Treatises, with On the Unity of the Church, is in St Vladimir’s Seminary Press’s Popular Patristics series.
cyprian-church-svs.label: Buy On the Church on Amazon (Paperback)

nyssa-catechetical-svs.words: Would you like Gregory of Nyssa in print? His Catechetical Discourse is in St Vladimir’s Seminary Press’s Popular Patristics series, in paperback.
nyssa-catechetical-svs.label: Buy the Catechetical Discourse on Amazon (Paperback)

nyssa-soul-svs.words: Would you like Gregory of Nyssa in print? On the Soul and the Resurrection is in St Vladimir’s Seminary Press’s Popular Patristics series, in paperback.
nyssa-soul-svs.label: Buy On the Soul and the Resurrection on Amazon (Paperback)

athanasius-festal-lup.words: Would you like Athanasius’s Festal Letters in print? The Festal Letters of Athanasius of Alexandria, translated by David Brakke and David M. Gwynn, is in paperback from Liverpool University Press.
athanasius-festal-lup.label: Buy the Festal Letters on Amazon (Paperback)

leo-letters-cua.words: Would you like the Tome in print? St. Leo’s Letters, where the Tome is Letter 28, are in the Catholic University of America Press’s Fathers of the Church series.
leo-letters-cua.label: Buy Leo’s Letters on Amazon (Paperback)

augustine-teaching-owc.words: Would you like On Christian Doctrine in print? R. P. H. Green’s translation, On Christian Teaching, is in paperback from Oxford World’s Classics.
augustine-teaching-owc.label: Buy On Christian Teaching on Amazon (Paperback)

augustine-enchiridion-cua.words: Would you like the Enchiridion in print? It is in the Catholic University of America Press’s Fathers of the Church series as Faith, Hope and Charity, with three more of Augustine’s works.
augustine-enchiridion-cua.label: Buy the Enchiridion on Amazon (Paperback)

press-bibles.words: Would you like a Bible in print? Lérins Press keeps a shelf of editions we recommend for reading and study.
press-bibles.note: The Bibles page’s Amazon links are affiliate links.

press-catechisms.words: Would you like a catechism in print? Lérins Press keeps a shelf of catechisms and confessions we recommend for learning the faith.
press-catechisms.note: The Catechisms page’s Amazon links are affiliate links.
